name: WelcomeView
behavior: Empty child route under LayoutDefault opens first-run welcome and source-selection choices; file protocol uses hash history and Electron/non-file uses base-aware web history

name: GraphView
behavior: Graph workspace; initializes user and redirects to /user-select when login is required

name: UserSelectView
behavior: Select or create a server user before entering the graph workspace

name: cloud-login
behavior: Cloud login; authenticated users resume OAuth consent or user check unless switching accounts

name: cloud-signup
behavior: Cloud signup with optional Turnstile and post-auth redirect

name: cloud-oauth-consent
behavior: OAuth authorization consent and denial surface

name: cloud-user-check
behavior: Authenticated account status, verification, survey, and app routing

name: cloud-sorry-contact-support
behavior: Cloud access failure and support route

name: WelcomeViewAlias
behavior: Render the localized first-run welcome at /welcome and navigate to /install only from the explicit primary action; the empty child / route is the equivalent canonical WelcomeView entry.

name: InstallView
behavior: Require every install step to be visited, collect install path, device/GPU and Desktop settings, validate path state, track step changes, invoke installComfyUI once, then navigate to manual configuration for unsupported/custom setup or server start otherwise.

name: DownloadGitView
behavior: Explain the missing Git prerequisite, open the platform Git download destination on request, or let the user skip and navigate to the install route.

name: DesktopStartView
behavior: Render the localized initialising StartupDisplay while the Desktop shell owns startup and the next navigation decision.

name: DesktopUpdateView
behavior: Render localized update progress with a spinner and keyboard-operable console-log drawer; dispose the Desktop validation subscription when the route unmounts.

name: ServerStartView
behavior: Subscribe to Desktop progress and install-stage updates, render stage/message/percentage and terminal output, distinguish critical error state, and expose report issue, logs and troubleshooting actions.

name: ManualConfigurationView
behavior: Show localized custom Python/venv requirements and the virtual-environment path, then relaunch only from the explicit Manual configuration complete action.

name: MetricsConsentView
behavior: Show current metrics consent, privacy-policy link and enable/disable choice; persist through the Desktop settings bridge and return to the root welcome flow.

name: MaintenanceView
behavior: Project maintenance task status, all/error filters, unsafe-migration reason, terminal drawer and validation refresh; continue only after the refreshed task set contains no unresolved error.

name: NotSupportedView
behavior: Explain unsupported hardware/platform status and offer documentation, issue reporting, or an explicit continue-to-install path.

name: DesktopDialogView
behavior: Resolve dialogId through the Desktop dialog registry, render localized title/message and source-ordered buttons, and send the chosen returnValue through electronAPI().Dialog.clickButton.
